## Checklist

- [ ] Targets the **`dev`** branch (not `master`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org)
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes locally
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes locally
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated where it matters
- [ ] Existing tests still pass
- [ ] Screenshots / clips included for any UI change
- [ ] No secrets, `.env.local`, or scratch files committed
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or conventions changed (`README.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
